task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement 8 steps of a discrete-time quantum walk on a cycle of 0 nodes in Qiskit (position register + coin qubit, increment/decrement circuits), and print the final position distribution showing ballistic spread. Your answer must be the complete working code only, runnable from top to bottom.
